# Squarespace

> Squarespace is an all-in-one website builder and business platform combining AI-powered design tools, ecommerce capabilities, and integrated business management features.

Squarespace provides a comprehensive suite of tools for creating professional websites, selling products and services, managing bookings, processing payments, and marketing online. The platform leverages generative AI through Blueprint AI and Design Intelligence to streamline website creation for entrepreneurs, creators, and small businesses.

## Key Topics

- Fluid Engine
- Blueprint AI
- Design Intelligence
- Squarespace Payments
- Acuity Scheduling
- Ecommerce
- Website Builder
- AI Website Creation
- Drag-and-Drop Editor
- Payment Processing
- Analytics
- Email Campaigns
- Content Monetization
- Service Booking
- Online Store

## Website Creation & Design

- [Website Builder – Easily Create Your Own Website](https://www.squarespace.com): Squarespace homepage: website builder with templates, AI tools, domain names
- [Design a Website: The Leader in Website Design](https://www.squarespace.com/website-design): Squarespace design tools: Fluid Engine, Blueprint AI, Design Intelligence
- [AI Website Builder: Create a Website in Minutes with AI](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/ai-website-builder): Blueprint AI Builder: create professional websites in minutes with AI
- [Design Intelligence: Generative AI Tools](https://www.squarespace.com/design-intelligence): Design Intelligence: generative AI guidance for website creation

## Ecommerce & Online Stores

- [Ecommerce Website Builder - Start an Online Store](https://www.squarespace.com/ecommerce-website): Ecommerce builder: sell products, services, content with AI tools
- [Grow your Business with an Online Store](https://www.squarespace.com/online-stores): Online store platform: product management, checkout, shipping, POS
- [Ecommerce Website Design - Ecommerce Templates](https://www.squarespace.com/ecommerce/designs-that-sell): Ecommerce templates: product merchandising, inventory, mobile-optimized

## Business Services & Bookings

- [Sell Services: Events, Consulting, and Experiences](https://www.squarespace.com/services): Services platform: booking, invoicing, payments for events, consulting
- [Acuity Scheduling by Squarespace](https://www.squarespace.com/scheduling): Acuity Scheduling: appointment booking, calendar management, payments
- [Invoicing: Online Invoice Software](https://www.squarespace.com/invoicing): Invoicing tool: Pay Link, Tap to Pay, mobile app for payment processing

## Content Monetization & Digital Products

- [Digital Products: Sell Content & Memberships](https://www.squarespace.com/content): Digital products: online courses, memberships, gated content monetization
- [Create a Portfolio Website - Online Portfolio Maker](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-portfolio): Portfolio builder with Fluid Engine, Acuity Scheduling, email campaigns
- [Create a Blog – Easy-to-Use Blog Builder](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-blog): Blog builder with Fluid Engine, analytics, monetization, drag-and-drop
- [Create a Fundraising Website: Accept Donations Online](https://www.squarespace.com/donations): Donations platform: fundraising tools, donor management, recurring gifts

## Analytics, Marketing & Payments

- [Squarespace Analytics - Website Analytics Tools](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/analytics): Squarespace Analytics: visitor insights, traffic alerts, conversion tracking
- [Digital Marketing Tools - Email & Website Marketing](https://www.squarespace.com/website-marketing): Marketing tools: Email Campaigns, AI copywriting, SEO, social media
- [Finance Tools for Business: Payments, Checkout & Capital](https://www.squarespace.com/financial-solutions): Finance tools: Payments, Balance, Capital for payment processing, payouts
